verdict.rationale: Square documents a dedicated Disputes API with a 'Process Disputes' guide and Sandbox testing. Its official MCP server (remote OAuth or local) lists 'disputes' in its service catalog, so an agent can discover and call dispute endpoints via make_api_request, and webhooks can alert it to new disputes. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the evidence-upload and submit-evidence endpoints (the pack contains only page titles), any hands-on or independent corroboration of an agent completing a dispute end-to-end.
